subject: Pipeline lock & deconflict playbook — weekly submission and call
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer, marissa_cole, lauren_bishop
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme-corp.com>, finance@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline lock & deconflict playbook — weekly submission and call

Team / Olivia,

Quick reminder: this is the weekly pipeline lock window for deals targeting Q3 close. Goal: confirm stage, commit status, and surface any cross-team conflicts before our Monday submission. Please do the following by EOD Monday (07/12):

- Update stage to the most conservative current status (e.g., move to "Commit" only if legal & procurement timelines are validated)
- Add a one-line rationale in the deal notes for any stage change
- Attach the latest procurement/PO ETA if available
- Flag any blockers that need leadership/ops escalation

I attached an export (pipeline_export_Q3.csv) and a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft.docx) for reference.

We’ll have a quick sync Tuesday 07/13 10:00-10:20 PT to review open high-risk deals; calendar invite to follow. If you expect a push-out, note the expected new close date in the notes and ping me directly.

Why this matters: finance needs a locked view for the weekly submission to close planning — inconsistent stages lead to under/overstating coverage and unnecessary waterfall adjustments.

If anyone needs help with the HubSpot update permissions, ping Marissa and I’ll coordinate a short session.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pipeline_export_Q3.csv (CSV, 120 rows) — MAP_draft.docx (Word)

To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole, lauren_bishop
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 12:32:00 -0700

- Flagged DL-5824 (Fintech startup) as "Late-Proof" — needs pricing escalation; tagging Marcus.
- No procurement ETA for Acme yet; asked Olivia to confirm.

I updated the CSV and uploaded my local notes to the shared Drive folder.

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2027 15:18:00 -0700

Thanks, Soojin. Quick update from procurement: our finance team is still reviewing the final SOW. Expected PO issuance window 2–3 weeks (best case). I attached a short timeline (procurement_timeline.pdf).

Two asks:
1) Can Karthik confirm whether a 3% promotional bucket was applied in the current proposal? We may need a short note for our procurement approvers.
2) We’d like a 10–15 minute slot in Tuesday’s review to briefly surface commercial terms before you lock the number.

Appreciate the heads-up — will update the HubSpot comments with the expected PO date once I have it.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Thanks everyone — quick follow-up after the sweep:

- Confirmed Acme (DL-5819) stays in "Commit" for the weekly submission with note: "Legal sign-off received; procurement PO expected 2–3 weeks per buyer (see attached)."
- I consolidated the high-risk list and highlighted two deals that require pricing escalation. See Drive link.
- Added the 10–15 minute commercial slot to Tuesday’s agenda at 10:10 PT (invite attached as weekly_call_invite.ics).

Action items:
- Karthik: add the promotional language confirmation (3% bucket) in HubSpot by EOD Monday.
- Marissa: run permissions check for three reps who reported limited edit rights.
- Soojin: finalize the submission and upload to HubSpot + notify finance after the call.

Will be on the call Tuesday; if anything changes, please update the thread.

Thanks,
